list_remove_fix.description: When the only source-validation error is banned attribute call: remove, structured candidate materialization rewrites simple container.remove(value) statements into list comprehensions and re-runs validation.

topk_fix.description: Prompts now explicitly require top_k ordering by value descending and key ascending, with sort key equivalent to (-value, key). Semantic mistakes are still evaluated by the full verifier rather than silently repaired.
